home.title: Retal Residence · Furnished apartments and villas in Al Khobar
home.description: Seven architect-designed residence types from 84 to 363 m², fully furnished, around a Clubhouse with pools, cinema and bowling. Gated, with 24/7 security.

residences.title: Residences
residences.description: Apartments, town villas and executive villas from 84 to 363 m². Every residence is fully furnished, with European appliances, a one-car garage and internet included.

clubhouse.title: The Clubhouse
clubhouse.description: Restaurant and café, mini market, 38-seat cinema, four-lane bowling, indoor and outdoor pools, gym and tennis, at the centre of Retal Residence.

living.title: Life at Retal
living.description: Three minutes to the British International School, a mini market on site and play areas between the villas. Everyday life at Retal Residence.

neighborhood.title: Neighbourhood
neighborhood.description: Retal Residence is in Al Khobar: 3 minutes to BISAK, 10 to Mall of Dhahran and the Corniche, 30 to the King Fahd Causeway.

contact.title: Schedule a visit
contact.description: Book a visit to Retal Residence in Al Khobar. Call +966 13 825 9600, message us on WhatsApp or send an enquiry.

hero.title:
Welcome to your
designer home
hero.subtitle: Furnished apartments and villas in Al Khobar.
hero.description: Seven residence types from 84 to 363 m², a Clubhouse at the centre, and security at the gate around the clock.

statement.text: Each residence is designed by architects as a place to rest, gather and live well, finished with high-quality fittings, fixtures and considered interiors.

design.title: Designed by architects
design.body: Lattice-screened windows, generous light and clear plans, fitted with European appliances and furnished throughout.

stroll.title: A short walk to everything
stroll.body: The Clubhouse sits at the centre of the compound: restaurant and café, mini market, pools and cinema within walking distance.

security.title: Complete peace of mind
security.body: A gated entrance, security on duty 24 hours a day, and every precaution taken to keep your family safe.

to live at Retal
residences.intro: From one-bedroom apartments to four-bedroom executive villas. Every home comes fully furnished, with European appliances, a one-car garage and internet included.

clubhouse.title:
At the centre
of the community
clubhouse.intro: Dining, family entertainment and sport under one roof, a short walk from every front door.

pools.title: Pools
pools.body: Indoor and outdoor pools, with a shallow pool for children.

games.title: Games
games.body: Billiards, table tennis and a video games room.

sport.title: Sport
sport.body: Tennis court, gym and a multipurpose hall for volleyball, basketball and indoor soccer.

everyday.title: Everyday
everyday.body: Restaurant and café, mini market, laundry, salon and spa, and a business centre.

living.title:
Days that stay
close to home
living.intro: School is three minutes away and groceries are at the Clubhouse. Here is how an ordinary week fits together.

schools.label: Schools
schools.title: 3 minutes to BISAK
schools.body: The British International School Al Khobar is a three-minute drive, and the early learning centre is inside the Clubhouse.

shopping.label: Shopping
shopping.title: A mini market on site
shopping.body: Daily essentials at the Clubhouse mini market. Mall of Dhahran is ten minutes by car.

healthcare.label: Healthcare
healthcare.title: The nearest hospital
healthcare.body: A ten-minute drive from the gate.

community.label: Community
community.title: Shared pools, courts and play areas
community.body: Evenings by the pool, weekends on the tennis court, children in the play areas between the villas.

security.title:
Security at the gate,
service at the door
security.body: Retal is a gated compound with security staff on duty day and night. Housekeeping and laundry take care of the rest.

neighborhood.title:
Three minutes to school.
Ten to the sea.
neighborhood.intro: Retal sits in Al Khobar, close to the Gulf coast, with Dhahran and the causeway to Bahrain within easy reach.

one-bedroom-apartment.name: One-Bedroom Apartment
one-bedroom-apartment.summary: 84 m² on one level, with two bathrooms.
one-bedroom-apartment.description: An open living room and kitchen with a breakfast island, a bedroom with its own dressing table, and a second bathroom for guests. Lattice screens soften the light at every window.

two-bedroom-apartment.name: Two-Bedroom Apartment
two-bedroom-apartment.summary: 141 m², two bedrooms and three bathrooms.
two-bedroom-apartment.description: Living, dining and kitchen share one long, bright room. The main bedroom has a walk-in closet and its own bathroom, and a separate laundry room holds a washer and dryer.

three-bedroom-apartment.name: Three-Bedroom Apartment
three-bedroom-apartment.summary: 174 m², three bedrooms, with a backyard option.
three-bedroom-apartment.description: A 6.2-metre dining room opens onto the living room and kitchen. Three bedrooms include a main suite with walk-in closet, and a backyard option is available.

two-bedroom-town-villa.name: Two-Bedroom Town Villa
two-bedroom-town-villa.summary: 179 m² over two floors, with a private backyard.
two-bedroom-town-villa.description: Living room, dining, kitchen and terrace on the ground floor, with a maid’s room and garage. Upstairs, a main suite with walk-in closet, a second bedroom, a balcony and a roof garden.

three-bedroom-town-villa.name: Three-Bedroom Town Villa
three-bedroom-town-villa.summary: 213 m² over two floors, with a private backyard.
three-bedroom-town-villa.description: A 4.7 × 6 m living room opens to the dining room and terrace, with a maid’s room off the kitchen. Upstairs are three bedrooms, including a main suite with walk-in closet, plus a balcony and a roof garden.

three-bedroom-executive-villa.name: Three-Bedroom Executive Villa
three-bedroom-executive-villa.summary: 236 m² over two floors, with a private backyard.
three-bedroom-executive-villa.description: A porch entrance, a 4.9 × 6 m living room and a dining room that seats eight, opening to the terrace. Upstairs, three bedrooms; the main suite has a walk-in closet and balcony.

four-bedroom-executive-villa.name: Four-Bedroom Executive Villa
four-bedroom-executive-villa.summary: 363 m² over two floors, the largest plan at Retal.
four-bedroom-executive-villa.description: Living room, dining room and family room on the ground floor, with a guest bedroom and its own bathroom. Upstairs, a second family room sits between three main bedrooms, with balconies and a roof garden.

shopping.label: Shopping
shopping.title: Groceries on site, the mall in ten minutes
shopping.body: The Clubhouse mini market covers daily essentials. Mall of Dhahran is a ten-minute drive.

healthcare.label: Healthcare

healthcare.body: The nearest hospital is a ten-minute drive from the gate.

community.label: Community
community.title: Pools, courts and play areas, shared
community.body: The pools, tennis court and games rooms are where residents meet. Between the villas, shaded play areas and outdoor fitness stations sit a few steps from home.

outdoors.title: Streets made for walking
outdoors.body: Tree-lined streets, shaded benches, outdoor fitness stations and play zones signposted at 15 km/h.

services.title: Help with the everyday
services.body: Housekeeping and laundry services, a supermarket on site and security on duty 24 hours a day.
